**To what extent do school resources (teacher retention and per-pupil spending) explain differences in Massachusetts high school graduation rates, beyond student characteristics? And does leadership disruption causally affect graduation?**

2017 -2025

1.  Descriptive: School Resources model -\> how much do resources explain grad rate
    1.  controls are student charcteristrics
    2.  look into teacher retention and per pupil spending
2.  Interaction: does teacher retention vary according to poverty?
3.  Causal: does principal's departure affect graduation rate?

```{r}
#| label: load-packages-and-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(skimr)
library(fixest)
library(marginaleffects)

code_cols <- cols(DIST_CODE = col_character(),
                  ORG_CODE  = col_character(),
                  SY        = col_integer())

hs_grad_rates       <- read_csv("data/hs_grad_rates.csv",
                                col_types = code_cols)  # 2006-2025
student_achievement <- read_csv("data/student_achievement.csv",
                                col_types = code_cols)  # 2017-2026
teacher_retention   <- read_csv("data/teacher_retention.csv",
                                col_types = code_cols)  # 2009-2026

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))

snap_year <- 2024 # year for cross section snapshots
```

```{r}
#| label: explore-data

skim(hs_grad_rates)
skim(student_achievement)
skim(teacher_retention)

pct_to_prop <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) x <- parse_number(x)
  if (isTRUE(max(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1)) x <- x / 100
  x
}

hs_grad_rates<- hs_grad_rates|> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_PCT"), pct_to_prop))

student_achievement <- student_achievement |> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_PCT"), pct_to_prop))

teacher_retention   <- teacher_retention|> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_PCT"), pct_to_prop))
```

```{r}
#| label: eda-interaction-grad

# Interaction: retention vs. graduation, by school poverty level
hs_grad_rates |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", SY >= 2017,
         GRAD_RATE_TYPE == "4-Year Adjusted Cohort Graduation Rate",
         STU_GRP %in% c("All Students", "Low Income")) |>
  select(SY, ORG_CODE, STU_GRP, GRAD_PCT, COHORT_CNT) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = STU_GRP, values_from = c(GRAD_PCT, COHORT_CNT)) |>
  filter(`COHORT_CNT_All Students` >= 20) |>
  mutate(low_inc_share = `COHORT_CNT_Low Income` / `COHORT_CNT_All Students`,
         poverty = factor(ntile(low_inc_share, 3), labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))) |>
  inner_join(teacher_retention |>
               filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", STAFF_DESC == "Teachers", TOT_CNT >= 10) |>
               select(SY, ORG_CODE, RETND_PCT),
             by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(poverty)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = RETND_PCT, y = `GRAD_PCT_All Students`, color = poverty)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Teacher Retention x Poverty: Graduation",
       x = "percent of teachers retained", y = "4-year adjusted graduation rate",
       color = "low-income share")
```

```{r}
#| label: eda-principal-event

# Event: teacher retention in years with vs. without a principal departure
teacher_retention |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", STAFF_DESC %in% c("Teachers", "Principals"), SY >= 2017) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(teach_ret  = RETND_PCT[STAFF_DESC == "Teachers"][1],
            teach_n    = TOT_CNT[STAFF_DESC == "Teachers"][1],
            princ_left = any(STAFF_DESC == "Principals" & RETND_PCT < 1),

  filter(teach_n >= 10) |>
  mutate(princ_left = if_else(princ_left, "Principal left", "Principal stayed")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(SY), y = teach_ret, fill = princ_left)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Teacher Retention When the Principal Leaves",
       x = "school year", y = "percent of teachers retained", fill = NULL)
```

**Data Filtering for analysis**

```{r}
#| label: data filtering


grad_type  <- "4-Year Adjusted Cohort Graduation Rate"

# school level teacher and principal retention

teacher_retention_clean <- teacher_retention |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School",
         STAFF_DESC %in% c("Teachers", "Principals"),
         SY>=2017, SY <=2025) |>
  select(SY, DIST_NAME, ORG_CODE, STAFF_DESC, TOT_CNT, RETND_CNT, RETND_PCT) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = STAFF_DESC, 
              values_from = c(TOT_CNT, RETND_CNT, RETND_PCT)) |>
  transmute(SY, ORG_CODE,
            sector= if_else(str_detect(DIST_NAME, regex("charter", 
                                                        ignore_case = TRUE)),
                                 "Charter", "District"),
            teach_n    = TOT_CNT_Teachers,
            teach_ret  = RETND_PCT_Teachers,
            princ_left = if_else(TOT_CNT_Principals > 0,
                                 as.integer(RETND_CNT_Teachers < TOT_CNT_Principals), NA_integer_))
            


# achievement sample: gr 3-8, ela and math, school
student_achievement |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("Public School", "Charter School"),
         STU_GRP == "All Students")
```

```{r}
#| label: clean-data
#| message: false

min_teach  <- 10   # schools with fewer teachers have very noisy retention rates
min_cohort <- 20   # cohorts smaller than this have very noisy graduation rates
grad_type  <- "4-Year Adjusted Cohort Graduation Rate"

# ---- 1. Staff panel: one row per school-year --------------------------------
# Retention in SY t = in the job in t-1 and still there in t.
staff <- teacher_retention |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", STAFF_DESC %in% c("Teachers", "Principals")) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(charter    = as.integer(str_detect(first(DIST_NAME), "Charter")),
            teach_n    = TOT_CNT[STAFF_DESC == "Teachers"][1],
            teach_ret  = RETND_PCT[STAFF_DESC == "Teachers"][1],
            princ_left = if (any(STAFF_DESC == "Principals"))
                           as.integer(any(STAFF_DESC == "Principals" & RETND_CNT < TOT_CNT, na.rm = TRUE))
                         else NA_integer_,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  # fill in missing years so lag() always means "previous year"
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  complete(SY = full_seq(SY, 1)) |>
  arrange(SY, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(teach_ret_4yr = (teach_ret + lag(teach_ret) + lag(teach_ret, 2) + lag(teach_ret, 3)) / 4,
         princ_dep_4yr = princ_left + lag(princ_left) + lag(princ_left, 2) + lag(princ_left, 3),
         # a "clean" principal departure: principal left after 3 years with no departure
         clean_dep     = princ_left == 1 & lag(princ_left) == 0 &
                         lag(princ_left, 2) == 0 & lag(princ_left, 3) == 0) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(charter))   # drop the filler rows complete() added

# Event year for Model 3:
#   first clean departure            -> that year
#   never had a departure            -> 10000 (sunab's code for "never treated")
#   had departures, none were clean  -> NA (dropped from the event study)
events <- staff |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(event_year = if (any(clean_dep %in% TRUE)) min(SY[clean_dep %in% TRUE])
                         else if (all(princ_left %in% 0)) 10000
                         else NA_real_)
staff <- staff |> left_join(events, by = "ORG_CODE")

# ---- 2. Achievement data: school-year-subject, grades 3-8 ------------------
# Composition comes from MCAS student-group counts. DESE labels low income as
# "Low Income" or "Economically Disadvantaged" depending on the year.
# Suppressed (small) groups are missing, so they count as 0.
ach <- student_achievement |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("Public School", "Charter School"),
         TEST_GRADE == "ALL (03-08)", SUBJECT_CODE %in% c("ELA", "MATH"),
         STU_GRP %in% c("All Students", "Low Income", "Economically Disadvantaged",
                        "Black or African American", "Hispanic or Latino", "Male")) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE, subject = SUBJECT_CODE) |>
  summarise(stu_n     = STU_CNT[STU_GRP == "All Students"][1],
            sgp       = AVG_SGP[STU_GRP == "All Students"][1],
            me_pct    = M_PLUS_E_PCT[STU_GRP == "All Students"][1],
            low_inc   = max(c(STU_CNT[STU_GRP %in% c("Low Income", "Economically Disadvantaged")], 0)) / stu_n,
            black_his = sum(STU_CNT[STU_GRP %in% c("Black or African American", "Hispanic or Latino")]) / stu_n,
            male      = sum(STU_CNT[STU_GRP == "Male"]) / stu_n,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(staff, by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(stu_n), !is.na(sgp), !is.na(teach_ret), teach_n >= min_teach)

# ---- 3. Graduation data: high school x cohort ------------------------------
# Kept from 2013 for the event study; Models 1-2 use 2017+.
grad <- hs_grad_rates |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", GRAD_RATE_TYPE == grad_type, SY >= 2013) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(cohort_n  = COHORT_CNT[STU_GRP == "All Students"][1],
            grad      = GRAD_PCT[STU_GRP == "All Students"][1],
            low_inc   = sum(COHORT_CNT[STU_GRP == "Low Income"]) / cohort_n,
            black_his = sum(COHORT_CNT[STU_GRP %in% c("Black or African American", "Hispanic or Latino")]) / cohort_n,
            male      = sum(COHORT_CNT[STU_GRP == "Male"]) / cohort_n,
            hom_fos   = as.integer(any(STU_GRP %in% c("Homeless", "Foster Care"))),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(staff, by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(cohort_n), cohort_n >= min_cohort, teach_n >= min_teach)

# ---- 4. Model variables -----------------------------------------------------
# Retention in 10-percentage-point units; low income and retention centered
# before interacting (reduces collinearity in Model 2).
ach <- ach |>
  mutate(teach_ret10 = (teach_ret - mean(teach_ret)) * 10,
         low_inc_c   = low_inc - mean(low_inc),
         poverty     = factor(ntile(low_inc, 3), labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High")))

grad_m <- grad |>                       # Models 1-2 sample
  filter(SY >= 2017, !is.na(teach_ret_4yr), !is.na(princ_dep_4yr)) |>
  mutate(teach_ret10_4yr = (teach_ret_4yr - mean(teach_ret_4yr)) * 10,
         low_inc_c       = low_inc - mean(low_inc),
         poverty         = factor(ntile(low_inc, 3), labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High")))

# Event-study samples: treated schools within 4 years of their event, plus
# never-treated schools
es_window <- function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(!is.na(event_year)) |>
    mutate(rel_time = if_else(event_year == 10000, NA_real_, SY - event_year)) |>
    filter(is.na(rel_time) | between(rel_time, -4, 4))
}
es_staff <- staff |> filter(SY >= 2012, teach_n >= min_teach, !is.na(teach_ret)) |> es_window()
es_grad  <- grad  |> es_window()
es_ach   <- ach   |> es_window()

# ---- 5. Sample sizes ----------------------------------------------------------
tibble(dataset = c("Achievement (school-year-subject)", "Graduation, Models 1-2",
                   "Event study: retention", "Event study: graduation"),
       rows    = c(nrow(ach), nrow(grad_m), nrow(es_staff), nrow(es_grad)),
       schools = c(n_distinct(ach$ORG_CODE), n_distinct(grad_m$ORG_CODE),
                   n_distinct(es_staff$ORG_CODE), n_distinct(es_grad$ORG_CODE)),
       treated_schools = c(NA, NA,
                           n_distinct(es_staff$ORG_CODE[es_staff$event_year < 10000]),
                           n_distinct(es_grad$ORG_CODE[es_grad$event_year < 10000]))) |>
  kable(caption = "Analysis samples")
```

```{r}

# corrleation between student achievement and grad rate

grad_m |>
  inner_join(student_achievement |>
               filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("Public School", "Charter School"),
                      STU_GRP == "All Students", TEST_GRADE == "10",
                      SUBJECT_CODE %in% c("ELA", "MATH")) |>
               select(SY, ORG_CODE, subject = SUBJECT_CODE, me10 = M_PLUS_E_PCT),
             by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(me10)) |>
  group_by(subject) |>
  mutate(subject = paste0(subject, " (r = ", round(cor(me10, grad), 2), ")")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = me10, y = grad)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~subject) +
  labs(title = "Graduation Rate vs. Grade 10 Achievement",
       x = "grade 10 % meeting or exceeding expectations",
       y = "4-year adjusted graduation rate")


# corr between grad rate and retention, modulated by achievemnet (grad rate x ach) vs ret
grad_m |>
  inner_join(student_achievement |>
               filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("Public School", "Charter School"),
                      STU_GRP == "All Students", TEST_GRADE == "10",
                      SUBJECT_CODE %in% c("ELA", "MATH")) |>
               group_by(SY, ORG_CODE) |>
               summarise(me10 = mean(M_PLUS_E_PCT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
             by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(me10)) |>
  mutate(achievement = factor(ntile(me10, 3), labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = teach_ret_4yr, y = grad, color = achievement)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Graduation Rate vs. Teacher Retention, by School Achievement",
       x = "teacher retention (4-yr avg)",
       y = "4-year adjusted graduation rate",
       color = "grade 10\nachievement")
```

```{r}
#| label: model-1
#| message: false


# Model 1: nested blocks. csw() adds each block cumulatively:
#   (1) student characteristics -> (2) + charter -> (3) + staffing
# Year effects enter as dummies (factor(SY)), which is identical to year fixed
# effects and lets marginaleffects compute clustered standard errors.

m1_ela <- feols(sgp ~ factor(SY) + csw(low_inc + black_his + male + log(stu_n),
                                       charter,
                                       teach_ret10 + princ_left),
                data = filter(ach, subject == "ELA"),
                weights = ~stu_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

m1_math <- feols(sgp ~ factor(SY) + csw(low_inc + black_his + male + log(stu_n),
                                        charter,
                                        teach_ret10 + princ_left),
                 data = filter(ach, subject == "MATH"),
                 weights = ~stu_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

etable(m1_ela, m1_math, drop = "SY", fitstat = ~ r2 + n,
       headers = c(rep("SGP ELA", 3), rep("SGP Math", 3)))

m1_grad <- feglm(grad ~ factor(SY) + csw(low_inc + black_his + male + hom_fos + log(cohort_n),
                                         charter,
                                         teach_ret10_4yr + princ_dep_4yr),
                 data = grad_m, family = "logit",
                 weights = ~cohort_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

etable(m1_grad, drop = "SY", fitstat = ~ pr2 + n)

# Average marginal effects (percentage points) from the full graduation model
avg_slopes(m1_grad[[3]],
           variables = c("low_inc", "black_his", "male", "hom_fos",
                         "charter", "teach_ret10_4yr", "princ_dep_4yr"))
```

```{r}
#| label: model-2
#| message: false

#| label: model-2
#| message: false

# Model 2: does the retention association differ by school poverty?
m2_ela <- feols(sgp ~ teach_ret10 * low_inc_c + black_his + male + log(stu_n) +
                  charter + princ_left + factor(SY),
                data = filter(ach, subject == "ELA"),
                weights = ~stu_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

m2_math <- feols(sgp ~ teach_ret10 * low_inc_c + black_his + male + log(stu_n) +
                   charter + princ_left + factor(SY),
                 data = filter(ach, subject == "MATH"),
                 weights = ~stu_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

m2_grad <- feglm(grad ~ teach_ret10_4yr * low_inc_c + black_his + male + hom_fos +
                   log(cohort_n) + charter + princ_dep_4yr + factor(SY),
                 data = grad_m, family = "logit",
                 weights = ~cohort_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

etable(m2_ela, m2_math, m2_grad, drop = "SY", fitstat = ~ r2 + pr2 + n)

# Effect of +10pp retention by poverty tercile
avg_slopes(m2_ela,  variables = "teach_ret10",     by = "poverty")
avg_slopes(m2_math, variables = "teach_ret10",     by = "poverty")
avg_slopes(m2_grad, variables = "teach_ret10_4yr", by = "poverty")

plot_predictions(m2_grad, condition = list("teach_ret10_4yr", low_inc_c = "threenum")) +
  labs(title = "Predicted Graduation Rate by Teacher Retention and Poverty",
       x = "teacher retention, 4-yr avg (10pp units, centered)",
       y = "predicted graduation rate",
       color = "low-income share\n(centered)", fill = "low-income share\n(centered)")
```

```{r}
#| label: model-3
#| message: false

# Model 3: event study around a school's first clean principal departure.
# sunab() = Sun & Abraham estimator for staggered timing; never-treated
# schools (event_year = 10000) are the comparison group. Period -1 is the
# reference. School + year fixed effects; clustered by school.

m3_ret  <- feols(teach_ret ~ sunab(event_year, SY) | ORG_CODE + SY,
                 data = es_staff, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

m3_grad <- feols(grad ~ sunab(event_year, SY) | ORG_CODE + SY,
                 data = es_grad, weights = ~cohort_n, cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

m3_ela  <- feols(sgp ~ sunab(event_year, SY) | ORG_CODE + SY,
                 data = filter(es_ach, subject == "ELA"), cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

m3_math <- feols(sgp ~ sunab(event_year, SY) | ORG_CODE + SY,
                 data = filter(es_ach, subject == "MATH"), cluster = ~ORG_CODE)

etable(m3_ret, m3_grad, m3_ela, m3_math,
       headers = c("Teacher retention", "Grad rate", "SGP ELA", "SGP Math"))

# Event-study plots: pre-period coefficients should be near 0 (parallel trends)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
iplot(m3_ret,  main = "Teacher retention",       xlab = "years since principal departure")
iplot(m3_grad, main = "4-yr adjusted grad rate", xlab = "years since principal departure")
iplot(m3_ela,  main = "SGP, ELA",                xlab = "years since principal departure")
iplot(m3_math, main = "SGP, Math",               xlab = "years since principal departure")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Average post-departure effect (all periods >= 0) for each outcome
summary(m3_ret,  agg = "ATT")
summary(m3_grad, agg = "ATT")
```

```{r}
#| label: save-results
#| message: false

# Saves everything the memo needs, so memo.qmd only formats results.
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Table 1: memo Models 1-2 (Stock & Watson-style table) -------------------
# Columns: (1)-(2) SGP ELA, (3)-(4) SGP Math, (5)-(6) graduation.
# Odd columns = Student Composition Model (m1_*[[1]]);
# even columns = School Staffing Model (m1_*[[3]]).
# OLS coefficients are in SGP points. Graduation entries are average marginal
# effects from the fractional logit, in percentage points.
# Shares are rescaled to "per 10 percentage points".
ols_terms  <- c(ret = "teach_ret10", princ = "princ_left", low_inc = "low_inc",
                black_his = "black_his", male = "male", charter = "charter")
grad_terms <- c(ret = "teach_ret10_4yr", princ = "princ_dep_4yr", low_inc = "low_inc",
                black_his = "black_his", male = "male", charter = "charter")

tidy_ols <- function(m, col) {
  ct <- coeftable(m)
  tibble(term = rownames(ct), est = ct[, 1], se = ct[, 2]) |>
    filter(term %in% ols_terms) |>
    mutate(key = names(ols_terms)[match(term, ols_terms)], col = col)
}
tidy_ame <- function(m, vars, col) {
  avg_slopes(m, variables = vars) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(term, est = estimate * 100, se = std.error * 100) |>
    mutate(key = names(grad_terms)[match(term, grad_terms)], col = col)
}

tab1_long <- bind_rows(
  tidy_ols(m1_ela[[1]],  "(1)"), tidy_ols(m1_ela[[3]],  "(2)"),
  tidy_ols(m1_math[[1]], "(3)"), tidy_ols(m1_math[[3]], "(4)"),
  tidy_ame(m1_grad[[1]], c("low_inc", "black_his", "male"), "(5)"),
  tidy_ame(m1_grad[[3]], unname(grad_terms), "(6)")) |>
  mutate(across(c(est, se), ~ if_else(key %in% c("low_inc", "black_his", "male"), .x * 0.1, .x)))

# Fit: R2 for OLS; squared correlation of actual and fitted rates for the logit
# (fixest's pseudo-R2 is not meaningful for a weighted fractional logit)
sq_cor <- function(m) {
  fit <- fitted(m)                              # predicted graduation rates
  y   <- fit + resid(m, type = "response")      # actual graduation rates
  cor(y, fit)^2
}

tab1_fit <- tibble(
  col = paste0("(", 1:6, ")"),
  fit = c(r2(m1_ela[[1]], "r2"),  r2(m1_ela[[3]], "r2"),
          r2(m1_math[[1]], "r2"), r2(m1_math[[3]], "r2"),
          sq_cor(m1_grad[[1]]), sq_cor(m1_grad[[3]])),
  n   = c(nobs(m1_ela[[1]]), nobs(m1_ela[[3]]), nobs(m1_math[[1]]), nobs(m1_math[[3]]),
          nobs(m1_grad[[1]]), nobs(m1_grad[[3]])))

# ---- Figure 1: memo Model 3, Poverty Interaction Model (m2_* objects) -------
ame_pov <- bind_rows(
  avg_slopes(m2_ela,  variables = "teach_ret10", by = "poverty") |>
    as_tibble() |> mutate(outcome = "SGP, ELA (points)"),
  avg_slopes(m2_math, variables = "teach_ret10", by = "poverty") |>
    as_tibble() |> mutate(outcome = "SGP, Math (points)"),
  avg_slopes(m2_grad, variables = "teach_ret10_4yr", by = "poverty") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), ~ .x * 100),
           outcome = "Graduation rate (pp)")) |>
  select(outcome, poverty, estimate, conf.low, conf.high)

# ---- Event study (exploratory; m3_* objects), used in the memo's text --------
es_tidy <- function(m, outcome, scale = 1) {
  ct <- coeftable(m)
  tibble(term = rownames(ct), est = ct[, 1] * scale, se = ct[, 2] * scale) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "^SY::")) |>
    mutate(k = as.numeric(str_remove(term, "SY::"))) |>
    bind_rows(tibble(k = -1, est = 0, se = 0)) |>       # reference period
    mutate(outcome = outcome)
}
es_coefs <- bind_rows(
  es_tidy(m3_ret,  "Teacher retention (pp)", 100),
  es_tidy(m3_grad, "Graduation rate (pp)",   100),
  es_tidy(m3_ela,  "SGP, ELA (points)"),
  es_tidy(m3_math, "SGP, Math (points)"))

# Average post-departure effect and joint pre-trend test for each outcome
es_stats <- map_dfr(
  list(ret = m3_ret, grad = m3_grad, ela = m3_ela, math = m3_math),
  \(m) {
    att <- coeftable(summary(m, agg = "ATT"))["ATT", ]
    pre <- tryCatch(wald(m, keep = "^SY::-", print = FALSE)$p, error = \(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(att = att[1], att_se = att[2], pretrend_p = pre)
  }, .id = "outcome")

# Number of treated and never-treated schools in each event-study sample
es_n <- tibble(
  sample        = c("retention", "graduation", "achievement"),
  treated       = c(n_distinct(es_staff$ORG_CODE[es_staff$event_year < 10000]),
                    n_distinct(es_grad$ORG_CODE[es_grad$event_year < 10000]),
                    n_distinct(es_ach$ORG_CODE[es_ach$event_year < 10000])),
  never_treated = c(n_distinct(es_staff$ORG_CODE[es_staff$event_year == 10000]),
                    n_distinct(es_grad$ORG_CODE[es_grad$event_year == 10000]),
                    n_distinct(es_ach$ORG_CODE[es_ach$event_year == 10000])))

save(tab1_long, tab1_fit, ame_pov, es_coefs, es_stats, es_n, file = "output/memo_results.RData")

tab1_fit   # graduation fit values should be between 0 and 1
es_stats   # check these numbers against the memo text
es_n
```
